result.post_summary: Customer will verify the amount independently; agent held the stated balance.

transcript.text: Hello, this is an automated assistant calling from Example Service about your open balance. Our records show the total amount is $45, due on the 15th.

transcript.speaker: callee
transcript.text: No, that's wrong. It's $50, I have the paper invoice right here.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: What I'm showing is $45 on our side. You could check the number printed on your invoice statement, or I'll flag this for review and someone will call you back.

transcript.speaker: callee
transcript.text: Okay, I will check the statement tonight.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you. If the statement says otherwise, the callback colleague will correct it. Goodbye.
